Header board Easter eggs (lane E1)

The agreed board N-r8-01, now and then with a very light scatter of chopped chives, onion and herbs baked in. 32 eggs in 3 rounds; 8 finals. Every egg is the whole tile (same size, 1x/2x/3x, no seam), checked pixel by pixel after encoding: cream text stays 5:1 or better on every pixel of the bar. Grades: B beauty, F believable food, L lightness, R readability, T fit (strict, out of 10).

How often (proposal)
  • 1 day in 7 the board carries an egg; the other 6 days it is plain N-r8-01. (The old site: 15 visits in 100 had food on the board, 15 had knife marks, 70 were plain. Knife marks are cut: they do not show.)
  • Picked by the date, not at random: the same FNV-1a hash of the local day that boardVariantIndex already uses in Header.tsx. Same egg on every screen and every device all day; it changes at the person's midnight.
  • Which egg: the same hash picks one of the finals, so eggs never come in a fixed order.
  • Static pictures only, no motion. The board, the name and the account never move.
